item.description:
### Added - Background mode & Settings (`⌘,` or the header **Settings** button): closing the window now keeps Pulse sampling in the menu bar by default; customize **Start at login** (runs a background sampler so data is warm right after boot), **When the window is closed**, and **Keep dashboard in memory** from the in-dashboard Settings modal, the native Settings window, or the menu-bar quick toggles - Memory explainer & "Purge disk cache": click `i` on the Memory card (or any pool in the legend) to see live wired, compressed, and file-cache sparklines and clear reclaimable disk cache via Touch ID or password - Quick actions & keyboard navigation: right-click any app or process for Quit, Force Quit, Terminate, and Force Kill; press `⌘F` or `/` to search and `Esc` to dismiss menus, popovers, the drawer, or active search - Process list now includes `kernel_task` alongside other system processes
### Changed - Much lighter background footprint: releasing the web view on window close and tuning the sampler cuts background RAM to ~80 MB while reopening in under 0.2 seconds - Redesigned Memory and Network cards: memory figures now match Activity Monitor ("Memory Used", per-app footprint, and Cached Files) with a 2×2 legend, and Network shows combined ↓ + ↑ throughput - Menu-bar item now always displays compact vertical CPU and memory capsule bars with tighter spacing
### Fixed - Cold launches show an immediate connecting skeleton without main-thread stalls, and the dashboard and background sampler stay in sync across app updates - Fixed compressed-memory reporting, CPU card blips after process actions, battery charging-bolt state on AC hold, and right-click text selection
